sourceCode: _pretenured_on: aCollection   "Answer an instance of me, streaming over the elements of aCollection."   ^ self basicNewTenured on: aCollection
_pretenured_named: aString   ^ self newTenured        name: aString;        yourself

_pretenured_at: key ifAbsent: aBlock   "Answer the value associated with the key or, if key isn't found,	answer the result of evaluating aBlock."   ^ ((array at: (self findElementOrNil: key))         ifNil: [ aBlock ]         ifNotNil: [ :assoc | assoc ]) value

_pretenured_dangling: reference to: serial   (reminderDict       _pretenured_at: serial       ifAbsentPut: [ OrderedCollection newTenured ]) add: reference.   numberOfDanglingReferences := numberOfDanglingReferences + 1.   ^ reference
_pretenured_on: element opposite: oppositeSelector   ^ self newTenured        with: element opposite: oppositeSelector;        yourself

_pretenured_newFrom: aCollection   "Answer an instance of me containing the same elements as aCollection."   "(Set newFrom: {1. 2. 3}) >>> #( 1 2 3) asSet"   "({1. 2. 3} as: Set) >>> #( 1 2 3) asSet"   | newCollection |   newCollection := self newTenured: aCollection size.   newCollection addAll: aCollection.   ^ newCollection
_pretenured_key: newKey value: newValue   "Answer an instance of me with the arguments as the key and value of	the association."   ^ self basicNewTenured key: newKey value: newValue

_pretenured_at: key ifAbsentPut: aBlock   "Return the value at the given key.	If the key is not included in the receiver store and return the result	of evaluating aBlock as the new value."   ^ self        _pretenured_at: key        ifAbsent: [ self at: key put: aBlock value ]
_pretenured_with: aFutureAttribute   ^ self newTenured        parentProperty: aFutureAttribute;        yourself

_pretenured_new: newSize streamContents: blockWithArg   "A variant of #streamContents: where the initial or even final size is given to optimize memory consumption"   "(Array new: 3 streamContents: [ :out | 3 timesRepeat: [ out nextPut: 42 ] ]) >>> #(42 42 42)"   | stream |   stream := WriteStream _pretenured_on:                (self streamSpecies new: newSize).   blockWithArg value: stream.   "If the write position of stream is at the end of the internal buffer of stream (originalContents),	we can return it directly instead of making a copy as contents would do"   ^ stream position = stream originalContents size        ifTrue: [ stream originalContents ]        ifFalse: [ stream contents ]
newTenured   ^ self newTenured: 4
newTenured   ^ self newTenured: 4
_pretenured_in: anImporter named: aString   ^ self newTenured        in: anImporter named: aString;        yourself
_pretenured_on: anObject slot: aFMRelationSlot   ^ self newTenured owner: anObject slot: aFMRelationSlot

at: key put: anObject   "Set the value at key to be anObject.  If key is not found, create a	new entry for key and set is value to anObject. Answer anObject."   "(Dictionary new at: #color put: #blue; yourself) >>> (Dictionary new add: #color->#blue; yourself)"   "(Dictionary new at: #color put: #blue; at: #color put: #red; yourself) >>> (Dictionary new add: #color->#red; yourself)"   | index assoc |   index := self findElementOrNil: key.   assoc := array at: index.   assoc      ifNil: [            self               atNewIndex: index               put: (Association _pretenured_key: key value: anObject) ]      ifNotNil: [ assoc value: anObject ].   ^ anObject

referenceNumber: serial   self addToValues: (self importer entityAt: serial ifAbsent: [             self importer                _pretenured_dangling:                (FMDanglingReference _pretenured_with: self)                to: serial ])

copyWith: newElement   "Answer a copy of the receiver that is 1 bigger than the receiver and has	newElement at the last element."   | newIC |   newIC := self species newTenured: self size + 1.   newIC      replaceFrom: 1      to: self size      with: self      startingAt: 1.   newIC at: newIC size put: newElement.   ^ newIC
createInstance   ^ implementingClass        ifNil: [ FMRuntimeElement new description: self ]        ifNotNil: [ implementingClass newTenured ]

processCompiledMethod: aMethod   | method |   method := aMethod.   "If the method is a reflective method we need to ensure it is compiled and use its compiled method.	A refelctive method is for exemple a method created via a metalink and that was never executed."   (aMethod isKindOf: ReflectiveMethod) ifTrue: [         method := aMethod                      compileAndInstallCompiledMethod;                      compiledMethod ].   self assert: method isCompiledMethod.   method pragmas      detect: [ :each |            #( #FMProperty:type:opposite: #FMProperty:type:               #FMProperty:type:defaultValue: ) includes:               each selector ]      ifFound: [ :pragma |            | prop |            prop := FM3Property _pretenured_named:                       (pragma argumentAt: 1) asString.            typeDict at: prop put: (pragma argumentAt: 2).            mmClassDict at: prop put: method methodClass.            pragma selector = #FMProperty:type:defaultValue: ifTrue: [               prop defaultValue: (pragma argumentAt: 3) ].            pragma selector = #FMProperty:type:opposite: ifTrue: [               oppositeDict at: prop put: (pragma argumentAt: 3) ].            self processInfosFrom: method for: prop.            elements add: prop ]

beginEntity: name   | translatedName |   translatedName := self translationUnit translate: name.   stack push:      (FMFutureEntity _pretenured_in: self named: translatedName)
initialize   super initialize.   properties := FMMultivalueLink                    _pretenured_on: self                    opposite: #mmClass:.   traits := Set newTenured

as: aSimilarClass   "Create an object of class aSimilarClass that has similar contents to the receiver if the object is not already an instance of this class."   aSimilarClass == self class ifTrue: [ ^ self ].   ^ aSimilarClass _pretenured_newFrom: self
initialize   super initialize.   keys := Array newTenured: 2.   values := Array newTenured: 2.   size := 0

initialize   super initialize.   isAbstract := false.   superclass := self class defaultSuperclass.   subclasses := FMMultivalueLink                    _pretenured_on: self                    opposite: #superclass:

grow   "Grow the elements array and reinsert the old elements"   | oldElements |   oldElements := array.   array := Array newTenured:               (HashTableSizes atLeast: oldElements size * 2).   tally := 0.   oldElements do: [ :element |      element ifNotNil: [ self noCheckAdd: element enclosedElement ] ]

-> anObject   "Answer an Association between self and anObject"   "The following example creates an association whose key is number 1 and value string 'one'."   "(1 -> 'one') key >>> 1"   "(1 -> 'one') value >>> 'one'"   "Note that key and value can be ANY object."   ^ Association _pretenured_key: self value: anObject

processTrait: aTrait ifPragmaAbsent: anErrorBlock   aTrait metamodelDefinitionPragma      ifNil: anErrorBlock      ifNotNil: [ :pragma |            | fm3Trait |            fm3Trait := FM3Trait _pretenured_named:                           (pragma argumentAt: 1).            superclassDict at: fm3Trait put: (pragma argumentAt: 2).            fm3Trait implementingClass: aTrait.            self extractPackageFrom: pragma method for: fm3Trait.            classDict at: aTrait put: fm3Trait.            (self methodsToProcessFrom: aTrait) do: [ :each |               self processCompiledMethod: each ].            aTrait localSlots               select: #isFMRelationSlot               thenDo: [ :each | self processSlot: each in: aTrait ].            traitsDict at: fm3Trait put: aTrait localGeneratedTraits.            elements add: fm3Trait ]

copyReplaceAll: oldSubstring with: newSubstring   "Answer a copy of the receiver in which all occurrences of oldSubstring have been replaced by newSubstring"   "('ab cd ab ef ab' copyReplaceAll: 'ab' with: 'zk') >>> 'zk cd zk ef zk'"   | idx |   self = oldSubstring ifTrue: [ ^ newSubstring copy ].   oldSubstring isEmpty ifTrue: [ ^ self copy ].   idx := 1.   ^ self species        _pretenured_new: self size        streamContents: [ :stream |              | foundIdx |              [              (foundIdx := self                              findString: oldSubstring                              startingAt: idx) isZero ] whileFalse: [                    stream                       next: foundIdx - idx                       putAll: self                       startingAt: idx;                       nextPutAll: newSubstring.                    idx := foundIdx + oldSubstring size ].              idx <= self size ifTrue: [                 stream                    next: self size - idx + 1                    putAll: self                    startingAt: idx ] ]

profileBenchmark   | profiler |   profiler := FiLiP new                  samplingRate: samplingRate;                  profileOn: [ benchmarkClass newTenured run ];                  yourself.   experiment := PathSensitvePretenuring new                    setUpForProfiler: profiler;                    methodProtocol: protocol;                    yourself

growAtLast   "Add new empty slots to the end of array, while keeping the empty slots at the front."   "OrderedCollection new capacity >>> 10"   "(OrderedCollection new growAtLast; capacity) >>> 20"   | newArray |   newArray := self class arrayType newTenured:                  (array size * 2 max: 1).   newArray      replaceFrom: firstIndex      to: lastIndex      with: array      startingAt: firstIndex.   array := newArray
createSymbol   ^ (ByteSymbol basicNewTenured: self size) string: self

new: newSize streamContents: blockWithArg   "A variant of #streamContents: where the initial or even final size is given to optimize memory consumption"   "(Array new: 3 streamContents: [ :out | 3 timesRepeat: [ out nextPut: 42 ] ]) >>> #(42 42 42)"   | stream |   stream := WriteStream on: (self streamSpecies newTenured: newSize).   blockWithArg value: stream.   "If the write position of stream is at the end of the internal buffer of stream (originalContents),	we can return it directly instead of making a copy as contents would do"   ^ stream position = stream originalContents size        ifTrue: [ stream originalContents ]        ifFalse: [ stream contents ]
